# Super Conscious

> Super Conscious is a creative production and engineering studio building brands, content, and digital products for founders and marketing teams. Based in Philadelphia, PA.

Super Conscious is a small studio of designers, animators, and engineers. We embed with founders and marketing teams to make brand systems, content programs, and digital products. We work month to month with no long contracts, and we treat every project like it carries the weight of the company.

## About

- [Capabilities](https://super-conscious.studio/about): What we do, how we work, and the disciplines we cover.
- [Careers](https://super-conscious.studio/careers): How we work, who fits here, and how to join the freelance roster.
- [Thoughts](https://super-conscious.studio/thoughts): Ideas, notes, and process from the studio.

## Disciplines

Creative direction, writing, design, illustration, film and photo, 3D and motion, animation, editing, production, engineering. All in-house.

## Services

**Build** (the foundation): Brand infrastructure / content, product design, web and interactive, decks, print and OOH, copywriting, concept creation.

**Grow** (the fuel): Growth infrastructure / content, social, long-form video, lead magnets, email and newsletter, lifecycle and retention, ad creative.

## Brand Systems — Questions

- [What does a brand system actually include?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/what-does-a-brand-system-include): A complete set of decisions about how your company looks, sounds, and presents itself — visual identity, messaging, voice, and the tools your team needs to stay consistent.
- [How long does a brand system take?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/how-long-does-a-brand-system-take): Most brand system engagements run 8–12 weeks. Discovery and strategy take the first 3–4 weeks; design and system build takes the remaining time.
- [How much does a brand system cost?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/brand-system-cost): A brand system from a professional studio typically runs $25,000–$80,000 depending on scope, from a focused identity system to a full brand platform.
- [What is the difference between brand guidelines and a brand system?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/brand-guidelines-vs-brand-system): Brand guidelines tell people what to do. A brand system gives them everything they need to do it — the document plus templates, components, logic, and training.
- [When should a company invest in a brand system?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/when-to-invest-in-a-brand-system): When inconsistency is costing you something — time, trust, or growth. Common inflection points include Series A funding, hiring a marketing team, or entering a new market.
- [What is a verbal identity?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/what-is-a-verbal-identity): The written equivalent of a visual identity — defining how your company sounds: the words you use, the rhythm of your sentences, and the point of view you bring to everything you publish.
- [How do you maintain brand consistency across a team?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/brand-consistency-across-a-team): With a system, not a document. Consistency comes from templates, components, and clear decision rules — not a PDF that sits in a shared drive.

## Content Programs — Questions

- [What is a content program?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/what-is-a-content-program): A structured, ongoing system for producing and distributing content — with a strategy, cadence, voice, set of formats, and a way of measuring whether it is working.
- [How do you build a B2B content program from scratch?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/how-to-build-a-b2b-content-program): Start with your audience and point of view, not a content calendar. Map your buyer's questions, pick two formats and one channel, then build the production machine.
- [How much does a content program cost?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/content-program-cost): A professionally run B2B content program typically runs $8,000–$25,000 per month depending on volume, formats, and how much strategic work your team handles versus the studio.
- [How long does it take for content marketing to work?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/how-long-until-content-marketing-works): Six months before you see compounding returns, twelve before the program is self-sustaining. Content works through accumulation.
- [What is a thought leadership program?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/what-is-a-thought-leadership-program): A structured effort to build a company or founder's reputation as a serious voice in their category — combining original points of view, consistent publishing, and strategic distribution.
- [How do you measure a content program?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/how-to-measure-a-content-program): With a mix of leading indicators (publishing consistency, engagement rates, ranking trajectories) and lagging indicators (organic traffic, pipeline influence, sourced revenue).

## Digital Products — Questions

- [What does a digital product design engagement include?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/what-does-a-digital-product-design-engagement-include): User research, interaction design, visual design, and a design system — the components and patterns that allow your engineering team to build consistently.
- [How much does product design cost?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/how-much-does-product-design-cost): A focused product design engagement typically runs $40,000–$150,000 depending on scope and duration, from a 6–8 week sprint to a 4–6 month full engagement.
- [How long does it take to design a web app?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/how-long-to-design-a-web-app): A focused web application design engagement typically runs 8–16 weeks. Research and definition take the first 3–4 weeks; design and iteration take the rest.
- [What is the difference between a design system and a brand system?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/design-system-vs-brand-system): A brand system covers how your company presents itself across every surface. A design system is specifically for digital product development — components, tokens, and patterns for engineering teams.
- [What should you look for in a product design studio?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/what-to-look-for-in-a-product-design-studio): Work that shows strategic thinking, not just craft. Case studies that articulate the problem before showing the solution, and a clear process for research, decisions, and handoff.

## Agency and Engagement — Questions

- [What comes first: brand or content?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/brand-or-content-first): Brand. But for companies already in market, content can start while brand is being built — as long as both are moving.
- [Do you need a brand system before you start content marketing?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/do-i-need-a-brand-system-before-content): Not a full system, but you need something to work from — a positioning statement, a voice definition, and a point of view on your category.
- [Creative studio versus freelancer: which is right for you?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/creative-studio-vs-freelancer): Freelancers are right for contained, well-defined projects. A studio makes sense when the work requires multiple disciplines working together and a single team accountable for the outcome.
- [What should you ask a creative agency before hiring them?](https://super-conscious.studio/lp/what-to-ask-a-creative-agency): The questions that reveal how an agency thinks — what they believe, how they handle disagreement, and whether they can show work that did not go as planned.
